title: How to order
note: PLACEHOLDER COPY. The MTO states described here are PROVISIONAL — PRD §9 makes the MTO workflow (deposit, queue, lead time, shipping trigger) a research dependency with Nana and the workers before checkout is built. Do not ship this page as-is.

seo.description: How ordering works at Yammaman — in-stock, made-to-order, deposits, and lead times.

props.heading: Made to order, step by step
props.intro: A made-to-order garment is a four-month relationship, so it is worth knowing what happens in it.

steps.title: 1 — Choose the cloth
steps.body: Pick from the fabric catalog. Anything still weavable is available, whether or not it is in stock.

steps.title: 2 — Place the deposit
steps.body: Made-to-order pieces are paid as a deposit up front, with the balance due at completion.

steps.title: 3 — The mill weaves and the garment is cut
steps.body: Three to four months. Your order sits in the mill's queue rather than a warehouse's.

steps.title: 4 — Balance, then shipping
steps.body: The balance is settled when the piece is finished and a label is generated to your address.

props.heading: Mixed orders
body: If your order contains both in-stock and made-to-order pieces, it splits automatically: the in-stock part ships now, the made-to-order part ships when it is finished. Each shipment gets its own label and its own tracking.

props.heading: Still deciding?
props.body: The fabric catalog is the place to start — the cloth usually picks the garment.
